instruction: Could you help me merge all PDF files in the "Paper Recommendation" email attachment in Thunderbird into one file and upload it to attachment_full.pdf in Google Drive? Make sure the content is readable and properly merged.

query: title = 'attachment_full.pdf' and trashed = false and 'root' in parents

metadata.explanation: Variation checks that the merged PDF contains expected text content from the GPT-3 paper. The gold PDF was verified to contain 'Language Models are Few-Shot Learners' (title), 'Tom B. Brown' (first author), and 'OpenAI' (organization) on the first page. This ensures the PDFs were properly merged with readable content, not corrupted or blank.
